title: CandidateFeatureVectorV1
description: Normalized candidate input vector supplied to the ranker after caller-enforced policy filtering.

candidate_id.description: Opaque candidate Story or package identifier.

author_id.description: Opaque author or publisher identifier used for diversity caps.

topic_tags.description: Normalized topic identifiers attached to the candidate.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag for the active candidate package.

published_at.description: RFC 3339 publication or latest visible version timestamp.

eligible.description: Caller pre-ranking eligibility attestation. Candidates with false are hard-dropped.

policy_blocked.description: Legal, safety, region, rights, or moderation block flag. Any true value forces 0% exposure.

followed_author.description: Whether the viewer explicitly follows this candidate's author or publication.

followed_topic_matches.description: Count of viewer-selected preferred topics matched by this candidate.

language_match.description: Whether the candidate language matches the viewer's preferred language list.

impression_count.description: Optional valid impression count for cold-start detection.

valid_watch_ratio.description: Anti-abuse-filtered fraction of valid video completion in [0, 1].

article_open_rate.description: Anti-abuse-filtered rate at which viewers open the connected written article.

source_inspect_rate.description: Anti-abuse-filtered rate at which viewers inspect attached sources.

anomaly_flagged.description: True when velocity or bot-pattern heuristics flagged engagement; engagement rollups are discounted to 0.0.
